svg.title: Country: security attribution before country aggregation
svg.desc: Daily US reports • Rust and Go • paired complete-date tasks • CSV and Parquet

text.tspan: Country: security attribution before country aggregation
Daily US reports • Rust and Go • paired complete-date tasks • CSV and Parquet
LOAD THE MASTER ONCE
160,000 instruments: 36 historical versions each, or one undated record.
Share immutable ID and effective-date lookups across workers.
PLAN 24 PAIRED DATE RANGES / 12 WORKERS
CSV: scan date boundaries. Parquet: inspect row-group date statistics.
Each task reads matching dates from the index and every portfolio.
READ ALL 175,200,000 HOLDINGS ROWS; CHECK INPUT FIELDS
1,095 dates: 100,000 index + 60,000 portfolio holdings per date.
Check dates, known IDs, duplicates, finite returns, nonnegative weights and daily weight sums.
LOOK UP COUNTRY ON EACH DATE; RETAIN US
Keep 99,000 index + 59,000 portfolio securities per date.
173,010,000 retained rows; non-US holdings are excluded.
NORMALIZE EACH SIDE; PRESERVE SECURITY IDs
Divide weights and contributions by the respective total US weight.
Contribution = normalized security weight × security return, separately on each side.
Build aligned per-security slots; retain one date per side per worker.
MISSING SIDE: COPY THE RETURN; KEEP ITS WEIGHT AT ZERO
Portfolio-only A: Wp = 2%, rp = 5%; Wb = 0%, set rb = 5%. Total US benchmark RB = 3%.
Allocation = (0.02 − 0) × (0.05 − 0.03) = 0.0004 = 4 basis points; selection = interaction = 0.
Benchmark-only: Wp = 0%, set rp = rb. The same rule applies to zero-weight sides.
Copied return is a formula input only: missing-side contribution remains zero.
COMPUTE BF EFFECTS FOR EVERY SECURITY IN THE UNION
A = (Wp-Wb) × (rb-RB); S = Wb × (rp-rb); I = (Wp-Wb) × (rp-rb).
RB is the total US benchmark return. Include securities absent on either side.
158,000 securities/date × 1,095 dates × 2 returns × 3 effects = 1,038,060,000 values.
SUM COMPUTED SECURITY EFFECTS INTO COUNTRY REPORTS
Sum allocation, selection, interaction, weights and contributions by country.
Reconcile effects to active return. Retain compact daily reports, discard security buffers.
COLLECT IN DATE ORDER AND WRITE 2,190 REPORT ROWS
One US row per date and return type; 20 columns including contributions.
No cross-date linking. Finalize CSV or typed Zstd Parquet after successful processing.
Full-data US IDs are disjoint: existing missing-side convention assigns active return to allocation.
Shared-ID regression fixtures verify nonzero selection and interaction.
Every execution validates attribution and writes the final CSV or Parquet report.
